correction: The forky opt-in section told users to run a direct registry `bootc switch` to :forky and back to :latest, as separate lines. bootc's registry-transport composefs pull fails on snosi images, a direct switch reads the system container policy, which root overrides can replace (ADR-0025), and separate lines go on after a failed pull or switch. The commands now run `podman pull --signature-policy /usr/lib/snosi/containers/bootc-policy.json IMAGE && bootc switch --transport containers-storage IMAGE && systemctl reboot`, as bootc-update-stage does, and the return to trixie uses `bootc rollback` while the trixie image is still the rollback deployment, because bootc refuses that switch. The same review also corrected the /etc statement (per deployment, not shared on rollback) and the kernel warning (Snowfield carries linux-surface).
